business_problem: Natura’s CRM team is responsible for analyzing the effect of campaigns across email, WhatsApp, and push channels. Before Databricks, vital metrics like engagement and incremental revenue were scattered in silos across legacy systems.
solution_summary: Natura Cosméticos built its Databricks implementation around Agent Bricks, Delta Lake, Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks AI Search. Natura’s CRM team is responsible for analyzing the effect of campaigns across email, WhatsApp, and push channels. Before Databricks, vital metrics like engagement and incremental revenue were scattered in silos across legacy systems. Agent Bricks provides the agentic and generative AI runtime used to build domain-specific applications. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment. Databricks AI Search indexes enterprise data for semantic retrieval and RAG-style search experiences. The solution also connects to WhatsApp, email, push, so teams can work from a shared governed environment instead of disconnected tools.
